title: Orchestrator payment challenge
description: The 402 body from a paid reservation or single-shot request, and the 200 body from /payment and /refresh-payment. Clients pass payment_params to the signer without decoding it.

payment_params.description: Base64-encoded OrchestratorInfo Protobuf; send it as the signer request's orchestrator field.

manifest_id.description: Becomes the session_id once the payment is accepted.
